slides.sub: This week's body tips in one place

sections.heading: Carrying bags and kids on one side
lines: Suitcase carry: heavy bag in one hand, walk tall.
20 steps per hand, 2–3 rounds, twice a week.

sections.heading: Gaming marathons
lines: Loading screen? Stand up for a 30-second reset.
Look slowly over each shoulder, 3 times.

sections.heading: Knee pain on long bike rides
lines: Squats, 10 reps × 3 sets, twice a week.
Add distance or climbing, not both.

sections.heading: Tendon pain: rest alone rarely helps
lines: Once or twice a day, tolerable discomfort.

sections.heading: Massage after a long-haul flight
lines: Walk 20 minutes in daylight when you land.
Moderate massage a day or two later.

sections.heading: Rolling out of bed with a sore back
lines: Knees bent, rock side to side 10 times.
Roll as one unit, then push up with your arms.

caption:
Hybi's weekly recap for Nov 30 to Dec 5.

A suitcase carry (heavy bag in one hand, standing tall) can help build the strength for one-sided loads. Tendon pain usually needs the right load, not just rest, so a 30-second calf raise hold is a good starting point. After a long-haul flight, a 20-minute walk in daylight often helps, with massage a day or two later. And with a sore back in the morning, try rolling out of bed as one unit.
